name: Core Infrastructure
description: Build the foundation: Firestore schema, Trend Discovery Agent, Pool Harvester
dependencies: Read CONTEXT.md to understand frontend expectations
Verify .env has OPENAI_API_KEY and FIREBASE credentials

tasks.title: Create Firestore schema helpers
tasks.description: Create v1/storage.py with FirestoreStore class that matches v1 schema (umbrellas, retrieval_pool, query_users). Must be compatible with existing user_profiles, user_preferences, user_patterns collections used by frontend.
acceptance_criteria: FirestoreStore class with methods: get_umbrella, create_umbrella, update_umbrella
Methods: get_retrieval_pool, add_to_pool, clean_old_pool_items
Methods: get_query_users, add_user_to_query
Reads FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH from .env
Does NOT modify existing collections (user_profiles, user_feeds, user_interactions)
tasks.verification_command: python -c 'from v1.storage import FirestoreStore; store = FirestoreStore(); print("✓ Storage initialized")'

tasks.title: Create umbrella data models
tasks.description: Create v1/models.py with Pydantic models for Umbrella, SubQuery, PoolItem, etc. Must match schemas in AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptance_criteria: Umbrella model with: id, display_name, sub_queries (list), user_count, last_discovery_refresh
SubQuery model with: id, text, source_hint, user_count, last_searched
PoolItem model with: id, url, title, type, tags, umbrella_id, query_id, quality_signals, fetched_at
All models use Pydantic for validation
Models are importable and type-safe
tasks.verification_command: python -c 'from v1.models import Umbrella, PoolItem; print("✓ Models imported")'

tasks.title: Create Trend Discovery Agent
tasks.description: Create v1/agents/trend_discovery.py with agent that uses OpenAI Web SDK to generate 10 fresh sub-queries for a main tag. Agent reads trending topics and outputs short, specific queries.
acceptance_criteria: Uses OpenAI Agents SDK with ModelSettings(web_search=True)
Agent takes main_tag as input (e.g., 'AI', 'Frontend')
Returns JSON array of 10 short queries (2-4 words each)
Queries are specific, not generic (no 'best', 'latest', 'tutorial')
Prompt instructs agent to check HN, GitHub trending, tech blogs
Can be run standalone: python v1/agents/trend_discovery.py --tag 'AI'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/agents/trend_discovery.py --tag 'AI' | python -c 'import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(data)==10; print("✓ Generated 10 queries:", data[:3])'

tasks.title: Create umbrella initialization script
tasks.description: Create v1/scripts/init_umbrellas.py that creates initial umbrellas for common tags. Reads from user_profiles to see what interests exist, creates umbrellas, runs Trend Discovery for each.
acceptance_criteria: Scans user_profiles collection for all user.interests
Creates umbrella for each unique interest (deduplicated)
Runs Trend Discovery Agent to populate sub_queries
Saves to Firestore: umbrellas/{umbrella_id}
Idempotent: can run multiple times without duplicates
Outputs: 'Created 5 umbrellas: ai, frontend, running, design, music'

tasks.title: Create user-to-query mapper
tasks.description: Create v1/scripts/map_users_to_queries.py that reads user profiles and creates query_users mappings. This tells the system which queries have active users.
acceptance_criteria: Reads user_profiles/{uid} for all users
For each interest, finds matching umbrella
For each sub_query in umbrella, adds user to query_users collection
Creates: query_users/{query_id} with {users: [uid1, uid2], user_count: 2}
Updates umbrella.user_count based on how many users have that umbrella
Outputs: 'Mapped 100 users to 45 active queries'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/scripts/map_users_to_queries.py && echo '✓ User-query mappings created'

tasks.title: Create Pool Harvester
tasks.description: Create v1/agents/pool_harvester.py that searches active queries and populates retrieval_pool. Uses Tavily for now (can add YouTube/Exa later).
acceptance_criteria: Reads query_users to find queries with user_count > 0
For each query, calls Tavily API (or skip if TAVILY_API_KEY missing)
Stores results in retrieval_pool with: query_id, umbrella_id, tags, fetched_at
Deduplicates by URL
Deletes pool items older than 3 days
Can be run standalone: python v1/agents/pool_harvester.py
Outputs: 'Searched 30 queries, stored 287 items, deleted 45 old items'

tasks.title: Create daily batch orchestrator
tasks.description: Create v1/run_daily_batch.py that runs: (1) Trend Discovery for all umbrellas, (2) Pool Harvester. This is the 4AM cron job.
acceptance_criteria: Runs Trend Discovery for each umbrella (refreshes sub_queries)
Runs Pool Harvester to populate retrieval_pool
Handles errors gracefully (continues if one umbrella fails)
Logs to stdout with timestamps
Can be run: python v1/run_daily_batch.py
Exits with code 0 on success, 1 on critical failure
tasks.verification_command: python v1/run_daily_batch.py && echo '✓ Daily batch completed'

completion_criteria: Firestore has data in: umbrellas, query_users, retrieval_pool
